//: This repository's own gate configuration. It is also the worked example the documentation refers to: an artifact whose delivery boundary is not a deployment.
//watched: Hooks mark edits to the hooks themselves, the skill text and the scripts. The manifests are JSON and carry no extension the default list covers, so they are named here: a broken manifest is exactly the kind of change that must not be claimed as working unverified.

verification.//stage1: Everything that can be proven without leaving the working tree.
verification.//stage2: The boundary here is the plugin loader, not a server. Nothing in stage 1 can see it: static checks of the manifests validate one reading of the documentation, while the loader has its own. Both defects found on 2026-08-15 - a source path form the loader rejects, and a hooks declaration that made the plugin fail to load - passed every static check and were caught only by installing for real.
stage2: claude plugin list          # must read: Status ✔ enabled
claude plugin details cerberus   # must list Skills (1) and Hooks (2)
# and the installer path, which is a second, independent boundary:
# then drive the installed gate: mark a source edit, claim readiness, expect decision=block
verification.notes: Use an isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: installing into the real one changes the operator's own session. Verify against the pushed commit, not the working tree - the marketplace installs from GitHub, so an unpushed fix proves nothing. `claude plugin marketplace update` before reinstalling, or the cached copy is what gets tested.
